courses.subject: HEBR
courses.title: Elementary Modern Hebrew I
courses.description: Introduces the essential elements of modern Hebrew structure and vocabulary and aspects of modern Israeli culture. Aural comprehension, reading, speaking, and writing are stressed.

courses.subject: HEBR
courses.title: Elementary Modern Hebrew II
courses.description: Continued instruction in the essential elements of modern Hebrew structure and vocabulary and aspects of modern Israeli culture. Aural comprehension, reading, speaking, and writing are stressed.

courses.subject: HEBR
courses.title: Intermediate Modern Hebrew I
courses.description: Second-year instruction in the essential elements of modern Hebrew structure and vocabulary and aspects of modern Israeli culture. Aural comprehension, reading, speaking, and writing are stressed. An introduction to representative literary works is included.

source.text: HEBR 203. | 3 Credits. | Prerequisite, HEBR 102 . | GLBL-LANG. | JWST 203 .

courses.subject: HEBR
courses.title: Intermediate Modern Hebrew II
courses.description: Continued instruction in the essential elements of modern Hebrew structure and vocabulary and aspects of modern Israeli culture. Aural comprehension, reading, speaking, and writing are stressed. An introduction to representative literary works is included.

courses.subject: HEBR
courses.title: Advanced Composition and Conversation: Immigration, Ethnicities, and Religious Traditions
courses.description: Third year of instruction in modern Hebrew with an emphasis on Israeli culture, literature, and media. Students will immerse themselves in language communication while exploring authentic materials that showcase the experience of immigration to Israel.

source.text: HEBR 305. | 3 Credits. | Prerequisite, HEBR 204 . | FC-KNOWING. | JWST 305 .

courses.subject: HEBR
courses.title: Advanced Composition and Conversation: Zionism and the Hebrew Language
courses.description: Third year of instruction in modern Hebrew with an emphasis on Israeli culture, literature, and media. Students will engage in language communication while exploring authentic materials that showcase the history of Zionism, the Hebrew language, and immigration.

source.text: HEBR 306. | 3 Credits. | Prerequisite, HEBR 204 . | FC-KNOWING. | JWST 306 .
